items.resolution: Passed after owner relocation. It accurately limits the evidence to four disclosed multi-GPU training/inference workloads and hands training-collective semantics from Ch36 into Ch49 without duplicating the marker.

Ch66 turns stochastic Agent regression into an evidence-budget problem with executable assertions, coverage/history-aware case choice, repeated trials, raw trajectories, environment identity, and uncertainty. The text preserves selection-bias, random-audit, minimum-coverage, deterministic-critical-path, evaluator, token-cost, and unmodeled-failure boundaries; it does not promote the author's workflow experiments into universal reliability.

It preserves straggler, OOM, numerical propagation, data/order/step semantic, low-load/heterogeneous-workload, and dedicated-job coexistence boundaries, while restricting throughput claims to the disclosed A40/H100 systems and task mixes.

Passed. Ch25 correctly positions next-embedding prediction as an action-conditioned representation objective rather than a claim that pixel prediction is obsolete. The paragraph preserves encoder identity, target drift, collapse, causal-sufficiency and closed-loop validation boundaries, and the coexistence of pixel/structured simulators for fidelity and safety.
